meta.name: claude-local
meta.description: Local additions on top of the claude pack profile: rbenv/Ruby toolchain, the dotfiles gitconfig_os include, a writable BUNDLE_USER_HOME (avoids bundler falling back to a temp home dir since $HOME itself isn't writable), read-write access to the Claude Code install dir so `claude update` can write new versions, and a bypass_protection carve-out for the 'Chrome for Testing' crash-report dir Selenium's browser writes to regardless of --user-data-dir (this is the isolated test browser Selenium downloads, not the user's real Chrome profile, which stays covered by deny_browser_data_macos). Also allows Chrome for Testing to register its crashpad/rendezvous Mach services and lets chromedriver signal/inspect the Chrome processes it spawns, so headless Selenium system specs can start. The Chrome browser process additionally opens the IOPMrootDomain power-management user client at startup and issues app-sandbox read extensions over its own bundle for its child processes; both are granted below, scoped to the Selenium browser cache. Non-Chrome additions: the claude-carbon data dir its statusline scripts read, /usr/libexec for path_helper, and read-only gh/pry config files.
